lessons.title: AI concepts & terminology
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of ai concepts & terminology and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: AI and technology reasoning requires clear distinctions among data, algorithms, models, applications and users. Machine learning systems learn patterns from data; model quality depends on the task, data and evaluation method. Generative AI can produce content but must be evaluated for accuracy and safety. Focus on ai concepts & terminology. Identify the defining concepts, common misconceptions, relevant evidence and a repeatable solving method. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify what the question tests, select the method, reason carefully, then verify the answer against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log describing the misconception rather than only recording the correct answer.
examples: A AI & Technology Challenge question on ai concepts & terminology should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking every stated condition.
Create a new ai concepts & terminology scenario with one tempting distractor and explain why the correct response is better supported.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused AI & Technology Challenge activity on ai concepts & terminology: build a small table, diagram, worked example or practice set, then explain the reasoning.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on ai concepts & terminology: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on ai concepts & terminology without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item AI & Technology Challenge checkpoint focused on ai concepts & terminology; target at least six correct and justify uncertain responses.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished AI & Technology Challenge task demonstrating ai concepts & terminology and record the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction; convert errors into reusable practice rules. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving ai concepts & terminology.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
